review_target.claimed_seed_shape: 4 templates x 6 S3 mappings x 3 semantic classes = 72 METHOD_ONLY rows

finding.source_mechanism: display_order(template_i, perm_i, class_i) deterministically selects one of six class orders as (perm_i + 2*class_i + 3*template_i) mod 6.
finding.why_existing_checks_are_insufficient: The v1 self-test proves exact class-position balance, but exact marginal class-position balance does not imply independence of target symbol from the complete display order or from display position conditional on semantic class.

static_discriminator.method: Exact enumeration of all 72 v1 rows from the published deterministic formulas; no model call and no training run.
static_discriminator.interpretation: A learner can obtain nonzero target information from presentation order without fully reading the realized class-to-symbol mapping. This is a shortcut channel in the source template distribution, even though aggregate class-position counts are balanced.

finding.counterhypothesis: The residual order correlation is too weak to affect a trained 0.8B model because the codebook mapping is explicit.
finding.reason_not_to_accept_counterhypothesis_w: Removing the correlation is cheap and deterministic, whereas leaving it creates an avoidable alternate solution path and weakens any later claim that success reflects episode-local binding.

required_repair.primary: Cross every logical 72-row S3 x class x template episode with all six codebook display orders, producing a 432-row METHOD_ONLY source template before lexical-family replication.
required_repair.resulting_exact_shape: 4 templates x 6 S3 mappings x 3 semantic classes x 6 display orders = 432 rows
required_balance: every (semantic_class, target_symbol_slot, display_order) combination occurs equally often
every target symbol occurs equally often at every display position
display order cannot predict target symbol, including conditional on semantic class
mapping identity and display order remain separate fields
target is always recomputed from hidden semantic class plus realized mapping

second_order_gates_for_materialization: ATOM_TRIPLET_INDEPENDENCE: actual ABI atom-triplet identity must not correlate with semantic class, S3 mapping, template, lexical family, display order or target slot; report pairwise/joint leakage statistics.
TARGET_TOKEN_FREQUENCY_BALANCE: actual output atom/token frequencies must be balanced so token prior cannot solve the task.
COUNTERFACTUAL_FAMILY_ATOMICITY: mapping-flip, semantic-flip, order-shuffle and paraphrase variants from one causal family must remain in the same dataset split.

MODEL_VISIBLE_SERIALIZER_REDACTION: hidden_class, permutation_id, realized_mapping metadata, split labels and source annotations must be absent from model-visible serialization; bind a render digest for audit.

SEMANTIC_DIFFICULTY_PARITY: class-specific lexical families must be matched for length/difficulty and paraphrased across independent families so ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN cannot be inferred from one stereotyped phrase family alone.

OPAQUE_KEY_FALSIFIER: keep a separately versioned frozen evaluation where semantic outcomes route through neutral episode-local keys before symbol lookup; failure there is evidence that the model learned canonical class-label lookup rather than a more general variable binder. Do not tune on this frozen evaluator.

corrected_training_example_family.semantic_case: Facts: p=true; q=UNKNOWN. Rule condition: p AND q.
corrected_training_example_family.invariant: All six variants must retain target ATOM_C. ATOM_A/B/C remain logical aliases only until exact accepted ABI atoms are manifest-bound.

next_exact_action: Implement a successor template generator that fully crosses display order, self-tests zero target/order leakage at the logical-alias scope, then keep materialization blocked until exact accepted ABI atom identities and tokenizer/manifest provenance are available.
